name: Storepoint Store Locator
description:
Storepoint is a beautiful store locator app for any website — the multi-location map widget behind thousands of store locators, dealer locators, stockist finders, where-to-buy pages, and product finder maps. It works on Shopify, WordPress, Webflow, Squarespace, Wix, and every other platform, matched to your fonts, colors, and brand.

This connector puts your locator in Claude:
- Add locations by name and address — addresses are geocoded automatically 
- Update anything conversationally: hours, phone numbers, websites, tags, photos, descriptions
- Publish, draft, or delete locations
- Create and manage custom fields: booking buttons, social links, extra info • Get your embed code and paste your location map into any page

Ask things like:
- "Add our new Chicago location with weekend hours."
- "Update the phone number for the Portland store."
- "Add a Book Now button to our locations."
- "Tag every location that carries the spring line."
- "Give me the embed code for our WordPress site."

Connecting takes one click: sign in to Storepoint, pick a locator, approve. New to Storepoint? Start a free trial, add your first locations from Claude, and have a store locator live on your website in minutes — no coding required.

Every plan includes filters and tags, custom fields, spreadsheet import, and a free brand match by the Storepoint team. Search analytics, heatmaps with coverage gaps, and Google Sheets sync are available from the Storepoint dashboard on Pro plans.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Storepoint Store Locator to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Storepoint Store Locator to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.storepoint.co/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Storepoint Store Locator MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Storepoint Store Locator provides these MCP tools: create_custom_field, create_location, delete_custom_field, delete_location, get_custom_fields, get_embed_code, get_location, list_locations, update_custom_field, and update_location.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Storepoint Store Locator?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Storepoint Store Locator in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Storepoint Store Locator MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Storepoint Store Locator requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Storepoint Store Locator is developed by Storepoint Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
